scope: Assumed design basis of the P0b weldolet crack FE model: 6 x 1/2 STD weldolet on NPS 6 Sch 40S run pipe, 1.4404 at 250 degC, internal pressure. Mirrors the riser design-data register schema (id, parameter, value, unit, source_class, reference_ids, note, status_label).
decision_reference_format: decision:<ID> = owner decision board, save 2026-09-25T11:04Z (plan section 'Phase card decisions')

source_class_values.public: value read from a public manufacturer catalogue, distributor chart or datasheet listed under references
source_class_values.derived: computed from other register items; the derivation is stated in the note
source_class_values.assumed: engineering assumption with no public source
source_class_values.owner_decision: value or choice fixed by an owner decision card
source_class_values.missing_evidence: value supplied without any public source; listed so the gap is visible

conventions.note_format: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: <reason>. Confirm with <evidence>.
conventions.coordinates: run-pipe axis = global X, branch axis = global Z, crown of the run pipe at z = R_o; rho = distance from the branch axis; v = height above the run-pipe outer surface (v < 0 inside the run-pipe wall)

design_data.parameter: Run pipe outside diameter (NPS 6)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the run pipe size is an assumed design basis (owner card V01); the OD is the NPS 6 chart value 6.625 in. Confirm with the line list or piping isometric.

design_data.parameter: Run pipe wall thickness (Sch 40S, nominal)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: Sch 40S nominal wall 0.280 in from the distributor chart; no mill tolerance or corrosion allowance is deducted. Confirm with the piping class and a thickness survey.

design_data.parameter: Branch outside diameter (NPS 1/2)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: NPS 1/2 OD 0.840 in from the distributor chart. Confirm with the line list.

design_data.parameter: Branch wall thickness (Sch 40S, nominal)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: Sch 40S nominal wall 0.109 in (ID 0.622 in) from the distributor chart. Confirm with the piping class.

design_data.parameter: Weldolet outlet bore (= branch ID)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the reducing 6 x 1/2 weldolet bore is not tabulated in the public catalogue, so the outlet bore is set equal to the branch ID 21.34 - 2 x 2.77 = 15.80 mm. Confirm with the fitting manufacturer's drawing.

design_data.parameter: Weldolet height A (run-pipe crown to outlet weld end), 6 x 1/2 STD
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: A = 3/4 in from the reducing STD table (printed p.16); the fitting on site is not identified. Confirm with the fitting marking and manufacturer's data.

design_data.parameter: Weldolet maximum OD at the base B, 6 x 1/2 STD
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: B = 1 3/8 in from the reducing STD table (printed p.16). Confirm with the fitting marking and manufacturer's data.

design_data.parameter: Weldolet opening at the run surface C, 6 x 1/2 STD
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: C = 15/16 in from the reducing STD table (printed p.16); C is the base opening, not the bore. Confirm with the fitting marking and manufacturer's data.

design_data.parameter: Run-pipe hole diameter (cut to the weldolet opening C)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the hole is taken as cut to the fitting opening C so that the attachment-weld root sits at the hole edge and the bore is continuous; the public catalogue gives no hole size for the reducing fitting. Confirm with the fabrication drawing or WPS.

design_data.parameter: Attachment-weld root gap
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: numeric joint geometry is in licensed MSS SP-97 / B31.3 figures, not in any public catalogue; 1.6 mm is an engineering assumption (the catalogue only describes a spacer root gap). In the model the root gap is the height of the wetted root face above the run-pipe surface. Confirm with the WPS and fabrication drawing.

design_data.parameter: Weldolet base bevel angle (full-penetration groove)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: engineering assumption. Weld metal and weldolet are modelled as one monolithic solid of the same material, so the bevel line itself carries no stiffness change; it fixes the groove height g + (B - C)/2 x tan(45 deg) = 7.16 mm, where the weldolet outer cone starts. Confirm with the WPS and fabrication drawing.

design_data.parameter: Cover-fillet leg (both legs, at the groove/run-pipe corner)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: engineering assumption for the cover fillet over the groove weld; the toe on the run pipe is at rho = B/2 + 3 = 20.465 mm. Confirm with the WPS, fabrication drawing or a weld profile measurement.

design_data.parameter: Weldolet internal profile: straight taper from C at the root-face top (v = 1.6 mm) to the bore at v = A/2 = 9.525 mm, then the bore to the outlet
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the catalogue gives A, B and C but not the internal transition; a straight taper ending at mid-height is assumed. Confirm with the fitting manufacturer's drawing.

design_data.parameter: Weldolet external profile: cylinder of diameter B from the fillet top (v = 3 mm) to the groove top (v = 7.16 mm), then a straight cone to the branch OD at v = A
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the catalogue gives only the envelope dimensions; the outer contour is idealised as a cylinder plus a straight cone. The base is contoured to the run pipe (surfaces at constant height above the run-pipe OD) and blends to a flat outlet plane at z = R_o + A. Confirm with the fitting manufacturer's drawing.

design_data.parameter: Crack plane: run-pipe fusion face of the attachment weld
design_data.value: v = 0 surface (run-pipe OD cylinder), from the root at rho = C/2 = 11.905 mm toward the fillet toe at rho = 20.465 mm
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: a root flaw in a set-on attachment weld is taken as a lack-of-fusion type flaw along the run-pipe fusion boundary. This plane is normal to the branch-axis thrust carried by the weld (mode I under pressure), it contains the whole weld footprint (the longest ligament that must be exhausted, root to toe), and at constant rho it gives a closed crack front that a structured crack block can follow. Growth into the run-pipe wall or through the weld throat is not modelled. Confirm with the flaw characterisation (NDE sizing and orientation).

design_data.parameter: Weld metal properties equal to parent 1.4404
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: weld, weldolet and run pipe share one isotropic elastic material, so the contour integrals see a single material (a CINT stress-intensity requirement). Confirm with the filler-metal certificate and weld-metal tensile data.

design_data.parameter: Young's modulus of 1.4404 at 250 degC
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: linear interpolation of the datasheet values 186 GPa (200 degC) and 179 GPa (300 degC); 250 degC is not tabulated. Confirm with the material certificate or a cited elevated-temperature standard value.

design_data.parameter: Poisson's ratio
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: design-manual value (s.2.3.1), taken as temperature independent. Confirm with the material certificate or cited standard value.

design_data.parameter: 0.2 % proof strength Rp0.2 of 1.4404 at 250 degC (minimum); also the yield strength of the elastic-perfectly-plastic limit-load model
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the datasheet minimum 'according to DIN EN 10088-3' at 250 degC; actual proof strength is normally higher. Confirm with the material certificate and elevated-temperature test data.

design_data.parameter: Tensile strength Rm of 1.4404 at 250 degC
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: linear interpolation of 390 MPa (200 degC) and 380 MPa (300 degC) from an undated third-party-hosted datasheet; not used by the P0b FE model. Confirm with the material certificate or a cited standard value.

design_data.parameter: Ramberg-Osgood exponent n
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: design-manual value for 1.4401/1.4404 (Tables 6.4/6.5), a room-temperature design model; not used by the P0b FE model (the limit-load run is elastic-perfectly-plastic). Confirm with a measured stress-strain curve at 250 degC.

design_data.parameter: Fracture toughness Kmat
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: no public source was found; the value is listed so the gap is visible and it is not used in P0b. Confirm with fracture-toughness tests of the weld metal and HAZ at 250 degC.

design_data.parameter: Design temperature
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the temperature at which M-01, M-03 and M-04 are taken; thermal stress is not modelled. Confirm with the process design basis.

design_data.parameter: Internal pressure on all wetted surfaces
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: assumed design pressure applied to the run-pipe bore, hole wall, root face, weldolet bore and branch bore. Confirm with the process design basis (design pressure and operating envelope).

design_data.parameter: Closed-end thrust, applied as an equivalent tensile end pressure p r_i^2 / (r_o^2 - r_i^2) on the free run-pipe end and on the branch end
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the system is taken as closed (capped) so the axial pressure thrust is carried by the pipe wall; piping external loads (weight, thermal, restraint) are not included. Confirm with the piping stress analysis.

design_data.parameter: Crack-face pressure (base case ON)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the weld-root flaw starts at the wetted root face, so the fluid can enter the crack and load its faces; ON is taken as the base case because it is the physically connected condition and it raises the opening load. OFF is run as a sensitivity. Confirm with the flaw characterisation (open to the bore or embedded).

design_data.parameter: Base-case flaw: full-circumference weld-root flaw on the fusion face, initial depth a0 (measured from the root at rho = 11.905 mm along the fusion face)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: owner card V03 fixes the flaw type and a0; the flaw is idealised as a uniform-depth annulus, so the crack front is a closed curve at rho = 11.905 + a on the run-pipe OD. Confirm with NDE sizing.

design_data.parameter: Sensitivity flaw: part-circumferential semi-elliptical flaw at the crotch (theta = 0 deg), a/2c
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: owner card V03; a = a0 = 2.35 mm, 2c = 9.4 mm along the root circumference. Confirm with NDE sizing.

design_data.parameter: Weld footprint on the crack plane (root to fillet toe) = total ligament at a = 0
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: (B/2 + fillet leg) - C/2 = 20.465 - 11.905 = 8.56 mm; the remaining ligament of a state is 8.56 - a (6.21 mm at a0). Confirm with a weld profile measurement.

design_data.parameter: Declared crack-depth states (base case)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: steps of about 0.4-0.5 mm from a0; the last state (a = 6.0 mm, ligament 2.56 mm) is the deepest the crack block fits (N-03), which stops before ligament exhaustion at a = 8.56 mm. Confirm with the resolution needs of the growth analysis (P1).

design_data.parameter: Limit state: ligament exhaustion on the fusion face
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: owner card B03; depth at which the remaining ligament reaches zero. Confirm with the assessment procedure adopted in P1.

design_data.parameter: Second base case (owner card G15): crotch-plane root flaw shape, a/c (semicircular surface flaw on the bore)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: a root flaw in the radial-axial plane y = 0 at the +x crotch, normal to the run-pipe hoop stress, breaking the bore surface (hole wall and weld root face, rho = C/2). The bore line in the section is straight only from the run-pipe bore (v = -7.11 mm) to the root-face top (v = 1.6 mm), so the flaw must fit on 8.71 mm of free surface; a semicircle (a = c) is taken because the flaw length along the bore is not known and a semicircle is the usual assumption for a surface flaw of known depth only. Depth a is measured along rho from the bore into the attachment weld and run-pipe wall. Confirm with NDE sizing of the flaw length along the bore.

design_data.parameter: Crotch-plane flaw position and growth rule: upper tip held above the fusion line; self-similar growth downward and outward
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the upper tip sits 0.5 mm above the fusion line (v = 0), so the flaw contains the weld root and the adjacent hole wall; the 0.5 mm leaves room for the crack-block tube below the root-face top (v = 1.6 mm). The flaw grows self-similarly (a = c) with the upper tip fixed, i.e. downward along the bore and radially outward; centre v = 0.5 - a, lower tip v = 0.5 - 2a. Confirm with NDE sizing and a growth assessment of the flaw shape.

design_data.parameter: Declared crack-depth states, crotch plane (the F-04 states that fit)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the F-04 states for which the lower tip plus the crack-block tube (0.6 mm) and a 0.3 mm margin stay above the run-pipe bore, i.e. a <= 3.355 mm; 3.6 mm and deeper leave less than 0.5 mm of ligament and are not modelled. Confirm with the owner whether the crotch plane needs states beyond 3.2 mm (a corner-crack model after break-through).

design_data.parameter: Crotch-plane limit state: the lower flaw tip reaches the run-pipe bore (remaining ligament 7.61 - 2a mm)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the ligament of the crotch-plane flaw is the bore surface between its lower tip (v = 0.5 - 2a) and the run-pipe bore (v = -7.11 mm), 7.61 - 2a mm; it is exhausted (break-through to the run-pipe bore, leak path) at a = 3.805 mm, earlier than the fusion-face limit of 8.56 mm. Confirm with the assessment procedure adopted in P1.

design_data.parameter: Crotch-plane crack block: tube half-size d and box depth D along rho
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the P0a crack block (tube 0.6 mm as in P0a) is built in a box on the bore line, rho from C/2 to C/2 + 6.0 mm (inside the fillet face at the root-face top, rho = 18.865 mm), v from the run-pipe bore to the root-face top. Confirm with a mesh sensitivity if the model is reused.

design_data.parameter: Modelled run-pipe half-length (each side of the branch axis)
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: shell bending disturbances decay over about 2.5 sqrt(R_m t) = 2.5 sqrt(80.595 x 7.11) = 59.9 mm; the half-length 200 mm leaves 179.5 mm (7.5 sqrt(R_m t)) between the fillet toe (20.465 mm) and each end. Confirm with an end-length sensitivity if the model is reused.

design_data.parameter: Modelled branch stub length above the weldolet outlet
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: 40 mm is about 8 sqrt(r_m t) of the branch (sqrt(9.285 x 2.77) = 5.07 mm), so the end-pressure application does not disturb the weldolet. Confirm with the branch piping layout (valves or supports near the outlet are not modelled).

design_data.parameter: Crack-block tube half-size d and maximum modelled depth
design_data.note: ASSUMED - to be confirmed: the structured crack block (a square of half-size d around the front) must stay clear of the root face behind the front and of the fillet face ahead of it (fillet at rho = 20.465 - d at v = d), which limits the modelled depth to about 20.465 - 2d - 0.5 - 11.905 = 6.46 mm; the last declared state is 6.0 mm. Deeper states would need a smaller block. Confirm with the owner if states beyond 6.0 mm are needed.
